body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 4 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Trigger: An Action or Reaction imposes an ordinary mental or morale Condition on the target. Response (unopposed): Suppress that Condition until the start of your next turn; the target gains +1 Composure for that duration.

surges.html: The target may move 1 unit toward you; self moves freely.
The target reduces its next incoming Damage by 1 until the start of your next turn.
